events.verdict: Plumlee (PHX) and Davis (LAL) make incidental contact with each other pursuing the rebound.
Booker (PHX) places his hands against Vincent (LAL) as he attempts to establish rebounding position and he releases when the shot is made.
Plumlee (PHX) initiates contact across Davis's (LAL) right arm, affecting his shot attempt at the basket.
Durant (PHX) spins away from Reaves (LAL) and avoids dislodging him from his defensive position.
Davis (LAL) makes clean contact with the ball as he contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) does not overtly or abruptly extend his leg out during his shooting motion and the contact with Davis (LAL) is incidental.
The ball is loose when the shot clock expires and a 24-second shot clock violation is assessed to Phoenix.
Hachimura (LAL) and Dunn (PHX) engage during the rebound and the contact is incidental.
Dunn (PHX) is off-balance with his leg extended upwards as he attempts to control the rebound and although the ball makes contact with his leg, he does not intentionally kick it.
Booker (PHX) avoids stepping out of bounds when he keeps the ball in play.
O'Neale (PHX) establishes the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.

Reaves (LAL) and Beal (PHX) mutually dislodge each other from their rebounding positions and a double foul is assessed. Davis (LAL) has imminent possession at the time of the whistle and therefore, Los Angeles is given possession of the ball when play resumes.
Durant (PHX) commits a take foul on James (LAL). The foul occurs prior to James' upward shooting motion and is correctly assessed as a non-shooting foul.
Davis (LAL) briefly clamps Nurkic's (PHX) arm and releases as he goes to grab the rebound.
James (LAL) places his forearm against Nurkic's (PHX) side and the contact is marginal as Nurkic loses his balance.
O'Neale (PHX) bats the ball twice attempting to gain control of the ball. Upon gathering the ball, he legally takes a dribble.
Reaves (LAL) commits a take foul on Beal (PHX).
